subject: Request: Penetration test evidence & exec summary — access, redaction approach
body:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@firmlabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01 09:12 PST
Subject: Request: pen test report & exec summary for SOC2 evidence

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this — our SOC 2 auditor (ClearPath) asked for the most recent penetration test report and a one-page executive summary covering scope, methodology, and remediation status. We understand redaction is often required; could you confirm:

- Whether you can provide the full report under NDA or if you prefer a sanitized package + exec summary?
- What redaction controls you apply (IPs, hostnames, stack fingerprints)?
- A timeline to deliver sanitized artifacts and a remediation tracker we can use in the audit?

We need enough detail to validate remediation (CVE IDs, severity, remediation guidance), but the auditor can receive a viewer-based copy if necessary.

Would you also share the contact for your SOC2 point-of-contact?

Best,
Marta
Director, Information Security
FirmLabs Inc.

--
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@firmlabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-02 10:47 PST
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report & exec summary for SOC2 evidence

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and the context. Short answers up front: we can share an executive summary (PDF) immediately, and we can provide a time-bound, watermarked secure viewer for a sanitized/full report under a limited NDA addendum. We prefer not to send the raw full report by email.

Proposed deliverables and controls:
- Executive summary (one-pager): scope, methodology, top findings, remediation status (attached).
- Sanitized report in secure viewer: redactions for IPs/hostnames/asset IDs; preserve vulnerability metadata (CVE, severity, repro steps redacted to a high level), and explicit remediation guidance.
- Remediation tracker template (CSV): mapping vulnerability -> status -> expected completion.
- NDA addendum with ephemeral access and audit log requirement; we can DocuSign.

I attached: execsum_redwood_v1.pdf and a draft pt-access-matrix.xlsx that lays out our redaction rules. If this works, please confirm the auditor name and whether they need CVE-level detail or only a remediation attestation.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Security GTM, Redwood Inference
--Attachment: execsum_redwood_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
--Attachment: pt-access-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@firmlabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03 08:21 PST
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report & exec summary for SOC2 evidence

Thanks — auditor is ClearPath (contact: alex@clearpath-audits.com). They will need CVE identifiers and severity for validation but do not require full exploit steps. A sanitized viewer with CVE IDs and high-level repro categorization (e.g., "auth bypass via insecure token handling") is acceptable.

Could you also provide a small sample (1 finding) showing what redaction looks like? We need to get legal sign-off on our side before sending the DocuSign.

-Marta

--
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@firmlabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04 09:05 PST
Subject: Fwd: Request: pen test report & exec summary for SOC2 evidence

Looping in Legal (Lauren) and Engineering (Dev) to confirm redaction approach and to prepare an NDA addendum for DocuSign. Internal notes below — please do not share beyond this thread.

On internal next steps:
- Legal: draft addendum with ephemeral access, watermarking, no-derivative clause, and audit log retention for 1 year.
- Eng: prepare a sanitized sample finding and the remediations-tracker template; confirm timeline for sanitized viewer.

Thanks team — ETA requested by 2026-11-12 to fit FirmLabs audit window.

Jasmine

--Forwarded message ends--

From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09 11:32 PST
Subject: Re: NDA addendum language for PT report viewer share

Jasmine / Dev — reviewed. Legal is comfortable with a limited access addendum. Key bullets to include in the addendum:
- Access via secure viewer only (no download), time-bound (7–30 days configurable per request).
- Per-user watermarking, unique access links, and mandatory audit logging retained for 12 months.
- No redistribution; no derivative reports or public disclosure.
- Auditor exception: allow a named auditor (ClearPath / alex@clearpath-audits.com) to download a redacted PDF only if FirmLabs signs our addendum and confirms chain-of-custody.

I attached a redline of the addendum. Once FirmLabs confirms acceptance we can route DocuSign.

-Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
--Attachment: nda-addendum-redwood.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10 09:14 PST
Subject: Re: Technical redaction plan and delivery timeline

Hi all — technical notes on sanitization we will apply for the secure viewer:
- Remove/normalize: IPv4/IPv6 addresses, hostnames, internal asset IDs, exact stack versions (replace with ranges), and internal email addresses.
- Preserve: vulnerability identifier (CVE-YYYY-NNNN), severity, impacted logical component ("auth service"), and high-level remediation guidance.
- Rework repro steps to "high-level reproduction summary" (no exact payloads or PoC).
- Produce a MD5 fingerprint for each finding and include a mapping file so auditor/firmlabs can correlate sanitized findings to remediation tickets.

ETA: sample sanitized finding + remediations-tracker-template.csv by 2026-11-12; full sanitized viewer package (all findings) by 2026-11-17. We will also generate access logs export for any auditor review request.

- Dev Patel
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
--Attachment: remediations-tracker-template.csv (text/csv)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@firmlabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10 17:45 PST
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report & exec summary for SOC2 evidence

Thanks, everyone — that plan works for FirmLabs. We accept the NDA addendum language with the auditor exception; please send the DocuSign link and the sample sanitized finding. ClearPath will confirm whether they need a downloadable redacted PDF after we review the sample.

Can you also include a short attestation statement we can put in our SOC 2 evidence bundle that confirms artifacts were shared under the described controls? One paragraph is fine.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Marta
Security Director, FirmLabs Inc.

--End of thread--
